invariants.rule: Missing, source-unspecified, hidden or conflicted species facts remain explicit findings/unresolved state; validation, migration and import may not synthesize canon or defaults to force completion.
Every species/selection validation result distinguishes playable, incomplete, invalid and migration_required; a single active/inactive boolean is insufficient.

CharacterSpeciesSelection history preserves exact species/version, lineage/form/adaptation/choice selections, adjudications, grant/progression receipts and provenance through deprecation, replacement, pack loss and migration.

An incompatible or superseded species/version is never silently substituted; replacement requires an explicit target, authority/source evidence and attributable migration receipt/event while retaining the original history.
A governed migration emits a machine-readable receipt on success or an explicit discrepancy/recovery record for unresolved, incompatible, interrupted or blocked state.
Species import/export preserves stable identity, exact version refs, provenance, unresolved/conflict state and owner-domain references; shared mechanics are not flattened into species-local data.

A4 Character validation/migration/export, generic persistence migration, and authoring import/export owners retain execution/mutation authority; MVPS-12 supplies species-facing contracts, adapters/findings and fixtures only.
MVPS-12 does not compute current active species contributions or grant projections; deterministic runtime projection and active grant receipts remain MVPS-13.

enforcement.ci_step: Run MVPS-12 validation migration import-export regressions
